Select compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, standard type, standard relation, standard value, standard units, activity comment, target ChEMBL ID, target name, and target organism. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, then to target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures on molregno as an INNER JOIN. Join docs on doc_id to obtain PubMed ID and DOI. Filter for target name 'Pim-1 kinase' and target organism 'Homo sapiens', and for standard_type 'IC50' with standard_units 'nM'. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, standard type, standard relation, standard value, standard units, activity comment, target ChEMBL ID, target name, and target organism.
